_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values.
_docs: See README.md for instructions on finding device_id, device_ip, and device_key.
_rooms_comment: Map room IDs (0-4) to human-readable names. Discover IDs by running: python vacuum_cmd.py test-room --id 0
_templates_comment: Capture these with vacuum_listener.py while sending single-room commands from the app. See PROTOCOL.md.
_zones_comment: Named map zones. Coordinates in map units (200 units = 1 metre). Use 'python vacuum_cmd.py decode-zone <base64>' to extract corners from app captures.
_spots_comment: Named spot-clean points. Coordinates in map units.
